integrity: A direct finite checker is supplied and reviewed with the full written proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The full commuting graph includes the identity; a separate corollary treats the conventional noncentral graph. Generic cograph algorithms can compute its spectrum in principle and known twin formulas may imply the minus-one corollary; new content is the explicit orthogonal all-parameter semigroup-specific decomposition. Novelty priority is not independently certified. Finite checker tests do not substitute for the all-size proof.
title: Adjacency spectrum and orthogonal prefix modes of free left regular band commuting graphs
